candidates.name: extramammary Paget disease
support_spans: Solitary, indolent, erythematous plaque in the right axilla measuring 5 × 3 cm
Dermal tumor infiltrating the subcutaneous fat without epidermal involvement
candidates.why: The patient's presentation of a slowly growing subcutaneous node in the right axilla with progressive infiltration of the overlying skin is consistent with extramammary Paget disease

candidates.name: hidradenoma papilliferum
support_spans: Multiple GATA3-positive and estrogen receptor–positive apocrine glands in close association to diffuse tumor cell infiltration
candidates.why: The presence of GATA3-positive and estrogen receptor–positive apocrine glands is consistent with hidradenoma papilliferum

candidates.name: apocrine gland carcinoma
support_spans: Tumor cells diffusely dispersed between collagen bundles and lined up in an 'Indian file pattern' with basophilic nuclei and scant cytoplasm
candidates.why: The histopathological features of the tumor cells are consistent with apocrine gland carcinoma

candidates.name: mammary-like gland carcinoma
support_spans: Positive for: pancytokeratin (AE1/AE3), cytokeratin 20, GCDFP15, estrogen receptor, and GATA3 antibodies
candidates.why: The immunohistochemical profile of the tumor is consistent with mammary-like gland carcinoma

candidates.name: cutaneous metastasis of breast cancer

candidates.why: The presence of cytokeratin8/18–positive and MNF116-positive tumor cells in the sentinel lymph node is consistent with cutaneous metastasis of breast cancer
